import sys, os, json, math
os.environ['TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE'] = '1'
os.environ['HF_HUB_OFFLINE'] = '1'
sys.path.insert(0, '/root/autodl-tmp/openvla_deps')
sys.path.insert(0, '/root/autodl-tmp/openvla-repo/prismatic/extern')

import torch
from hf.configuration_prismatic import OpenVLAConfig
from hf.modeling_prismatic import OpenVLAForActionPrediction
from transformers.models.llama.modeling_llama import rotate_half

ckpt = '/root/autodl-tmp/openvla-7b-finetuned-libero-10'
config = OpenVLAConfig.from_pretrained(ckpt)
model = OpenVLAForActionPrediction.from_pretrained(ckpt, config=config, torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16, low_cpu_mem_usage=True, device_map='cpu')

lm = model.language_model.model
layer = lm.layers[0]

# Simulate the attention pruning hook logic
B, N, D = 1, 256, 4096
hidden = torch.randn(B, N, D, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
position_ids = torch.arange(N).unsqueeze(0).expand(B, -1)

normed = layer.input_layernorm(hidden)
head_dim = layer.self_attn.head_dim
n_q = layer.self_attn.num_heads
n_kv = layer.self_attn.num_key_value_heads

q = layer.self_attn.q_proj(normed).view(B, N, n_q, head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
k = layer.self_attn.k_proj(normed).view(B, N, n_kv, head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
v = layer.self_attn.v_proj(normed).view(B, N, n_kv, head_dim).transpose(1, 2)

print(f'q: {q.shape}, k: {k.shape}, v: {v.shape}')
print(f'position_ids: {position_ids.shape}')

cos, sin = layer.self_attn.rotary_emb(v, position_ids)
print(f'cos: {cos.shape}, sin: {sin.shape}')

# Apply rotary embeddings
q_embed = (q * cos) + (rotate_half(q) * sin)
k_embed = (k * cos) + (rotate_half(k) * sin)
print(f'q_embed: {q_embed.shape}, k_embed: {k_embed.shape}')
print('SUCCESS: All shapes compatible')
"
